motions.motion: approve the Conceptual Subdivision proposal from Jeff Kruckenberg from Alan Kruckenberg Construction for the Weyburn Retreat located at 1306 East Spring Lane based on the following: Findings: 1. Sufficient information has been received and reviewed by the city to show compliance with the requirement for conceptual subdivision approval. 2. A traffic study has been performed to examine capacity, safety and other concerns related to the proposed development. 3. As noted earlier in the report, the traffic study directly addresses many of the concerns and concludes that the subdivision street and access plan as proposed is appropriate given the level of proposed development. The study also includes a few recommendations to improve upon the plan such as striping Tobermory Lane and banning parking on the south side of Spring Lane with red curbs and signs. These recommendations should be specifically implemented as conditions of any future approval of the subdivision and conditional use permit. 4. Unified Fire Authority indicates support for the proposal. 5. Any corrections, edits to the concept plan as identified by City staff. The applicant was encouraged to work with staff to resolve the following: 1. Parking issues on Tobermory Way. 2. Return the road and fencing to its current condition. 3. Road widening. 4. Sidewalk issue. 5. Utilize the current church access for construction. City of Holladay Planning Commission Meeting - 04/21/2020 6 6. The City should consider the appropriateness of restricting parking on the south side of Spring Lane between 1300 East and Tobermory Ridge Road

motions.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Commission.
